verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of regions, edge locations, or nearest point-of-presence routing for Twilio Video media. The only related item is a Room property for 'TURN configuration'. That is an adjacent relay setting, not documented geographic edge or region selection. The axis clearly applies to a real-time video service, so missing evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, clients connect to a nearby point of presence and the vendor documents the regions or edge network that carries media
